comment: Which delays share one factor when fitting silicon_delays.json from ring oscillators (SKALP examples/delay_calibration/fit_calibration.py --groups). Each [pattern, group]: the first matching pattern wins, as in silicon_delays.json. Patterns are prjoxide switch delay classes and SKALP's Nexus cell types (OXIDE_*).

groups.stage: The LUT's own delay and the switches into and out of it. Every latch ring passes these three equally often, so they cannot be fitted apart.
groups.span0: span0 routing wires (and switches onto them)
groups.clocked: The clock network's wires and the flip-flops' own delays. Only the clock ring passes either, so they share a factor.
